backups.label: dictionary-and-navigation-guidance-release
backups.note: Official release fixing bundled English dictionary status and availability while updating launcher navigation, selection, and deletion guidance.

backups.label: contextual-short-word-correction-release
backups.note: Official release combining touch-aware short-word correction with compact conversational context and punctuation-bounded private grammar checks.

backups.label: deliberate-adaptive-learning-release
backups.note: Official release limiting adaptive vocabulary to explicit teaching and deliberate corrections, with six ranked suggestions and optional full-stop key.

backups.label: reader-ai-3d-reader-release
backups.note: Official release adding the configurable 3D Reader, opt-in Reader AI, responsive Reader settings, Attach Image, explicit teaching fixes, and safe test-install guidance.

backups.label: reader-book-ai-reliability-release
backups.note: Official release with compact Reader controls, reliable 3D settings, complete chapter summaries, and resumable per-chapter book quizzes.

backups.label: confirmed-learning-and-replacement-rules-release
backups.note: Official release adding confirmation-first word learning, session-only unknown-pattern review, editable correction rules, and deterministic exact replacements.
